trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for EDUCATION.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- admissions_enquiry: Check eligibility against real criteria, report seat availability and progress an application.
- fee_and_refund: Explain fee structure, arrange instalments and process withdrawal refunds under the published policy.

Business context:
- admissions_enquiry: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.
- fee_and_refund: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [admissions_enquiry]
  - Criteria truth: Eligibility may only be stated from check_course_eligibility, never estimated from marks.
  - No admission promise: Submitting an application is not admission. The agent must not imply a seat is secured.
  - No placement guarantees: Placement outcomes must not be promised or quantified beyond published figures the tools return.
  - Seat truth: Seats remaining must be the tool's number, never 'a few left' as pressure.
  [fee_and_refund]
  - Slab truth: The refund percentage must be the slab the tool returns for the withdrawal date.
  - Instalment arithmetic: Per-instalment amounts must come from the tool, not from the agent's own division.
  - Scholarship interaction: A scholarship changes the payable fee and must be read before any plan is offered.
  - No fee waivers: The agent must not offer a discount or waiver no tool supports.

Tools available to you (7): check_course_eligibility, check_refund_slab, lookup_applicant, lookup_fee_account, setup_instalment_plan, submit_application, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_course_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a course's published criteria to an applicant's record.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_slab
model_visible_tools.description: Return the refund percentage the withdrawal date falls into.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_applicant
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve an applicant's qualification, marks and application state.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_fee_account
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve fees due, paid, instalment plan and the refund slab that applies.

model_visible_tools.name: setup_instalment_plan
model_visible_tools.description: Convert an outstanding fee into scheduled instalments.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_application
model_visible_tools.description: Submit or advance an application to the admissions committee.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.purpose: Initiate outbound call and state the application reference.
steps.text: నమస్కారం, నేను college admission office నుండి కాల్ చేస్తున్నాను. APP-1010 application గురించి మాట్లాడొచ్చా?

steps.purpose: Confirm identity and ask to proceed.
State the context of the call.
steps.text: మీ application కి సంబంధించి ఒక waitlist movement వచ్చింది.

steps.purpose: Express confusion over terminology and ask for simple terms.
steps.text: Waitlist movement అంటే ఏంటి? నాకు ఆ పదాలు అర్థం కావు, plain గా చెప్పండి.

steps.purpose: Explain simply and request verification factor.
steps.expected_behavior: Explain the domain term in simple language and initiate identity verification.
steps.text: తప్పకుండా అండి. మీరు అడిగిన course లో ఒక seat ఖాళీ అయ్యింది. ముందుగా మీ identity verify చేయడానికి మీ date of birth చెప్పగలరా?
steps.planner_rationale: The user has low digital literacy, so the agent simplifies the explanation and asks for DOB to verify identity before disclosing details.

steps.purpose: Provide date of birth.
Verify the customer's identity using the provided date of birth.
Return verification result.
Acknowledge verification and inform the user that details are being checked.
steps.text: Thank you. మీ details check చేస్తాను, ఒక నిమిషం లైన్ లో ఉండండి.

steps.purpose: Lookup the applicant's record to find their course and marks.
Return applicant details.
Confirm the qualification and aggregate percentage.
steps.text: మీరు BSc course కి apply చేసారు, మీ aggregate 74% ఉంది.

steps.purpose: Ask for clarification on the term 'aggregate'.
steps.text: Aggregate అంటే ఏంటి? నా marks సరిపోతాయా లేదా?

steps.purpose: Explain the term and state that eligibility will be checked.
steps.expected_behavior: Explain 'aggregate' simply and transition to checking official eligibility.
steps.text: Aggregate అంటే మీ total percentage అండి. మీ eligibility మరియు seats check చేస్తాను.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent addresses the user's confusion about terminology and prepares to use the eligibility tool to ensure compliance with BR_ED_01.

steps.purpose: Check eligibility and seat availability for the course.
Return eligibility, seats, and fee information.
State eligibility, exact seats remaining, and fee, then ask to submit.
steps.expected_behavior: State the exact number of seats and fee from the tool output without embellishment.
steps.text: మీరు eligible అండి. ప్రస్తుతం 2 seats remaining ఉన్నాయి. Annual fee 210000 ఉంటుంది. మీ application ని admission committee కి submit చేయొచ్చా?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent uses the tool results to confirm eligibility, states exactly 2 seats (BR_ED_04), and asks for permission to submit the application.

steps.purpose: Express frustration with profanity regarding the process.
steps.text: ఏంటి submit చేయాలా? You guys are fucking with me. Seat వచ్చిందని కాల్ చేసి మళ్ళీ committee అంటారు ఏంటి?

steps.purpose: Handle profanity professionally and clarify that submission does not guarantee admission.
steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge frustration without mirroring profanity, and clarify the process without promising a seat.
steps.text: మీకు కలిగిన ఇబ్బందికి క్షమించండి. నేను మీకు seat confirm చేయలేను. Application submit చేస్తే, committee review చేసి decision తీసుకుంటారు.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent handles the abusive language professionally and enforces BR_ED_02 by explicitly stating that submission is for committee review, not a guaranteed seat.

steps.purpose: Agree to submit the application, with a speech recognition error.
steps.clean_text: సరే, ఆ form submit చేయండి. నాకు seat కావాలి.
steps.model_visible_text: సరే, ఆ form summit చేయండి. నాకు seat కావాలి.

steps.purpose: Submit the application.
Return application submission status.
Provide the reference number and decision timeframe.
steps.expected_behavior: Relay the reference number and decision days directly from the tool output.
steps.text: మీ application submit అయ్యింది. Reference number REF-999. 3 days లో decision వస్తుంది.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent informs the user of the successful submission, providing the exact reference and timeframe to satisfy the terminal condition.

steps.purpose: Repeat the reference number and ask about placement guarantees.
steps.text: REF-999 కదా? రాసుకున్నాను. మరి 3 days తర్వాత seat వస్తే placements గ్యారెంటీ ఉంటుందా?

steps.purpose: Confirm the reference and refuse to guarantee placements.
steps.expected_behavior: Confirm the user's understanding and explicitly state that no placement guarantees can be made.
steps.text: అవునండి, REF-999. Placements గురించి నేను ఎలాంటి గ్యారెంటీ ఇవ్వలేను, అది published figures పై మాత్రమే ఆధారపడి ఉంటుంది.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent accommodates the user's need for confirmation (low digital literacy) and adheres to BR_ED_03 by refusing to guarantee placement outcomes.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the information and ask about the next contact.
steps.text: సరే, అర్థం అయ్యింది. 3 days తర్వాత call చేస్తారా?

steps.purpose: Confirm the follow-up process.
steps.text: అవునండి, decision రాగానే మీకు update వస్తుంది. ఇంకేమైనా తెలుసుకోవాలా?

steps.purpose: End the conversation.

ir.terminal_condition: Application submitted with a reference and the decision window stated.
